description: The default scenario, then consumer-2 leaves the group: its row is STOPPED, and the config panel is locked while the simulation runs.

wait.jq: [.groups[] | select(.id == "orders-app") | .consumers[]] as $c | ($c | length) == 3 and all($c[]; (.raw.assignment | length) > 0 and (.raw.assignment | sort) == (.raw.targetAssignment | sort)) and ([$c[].raw.assignment[]] | length) == 6

[.groups[] | select(.id == "orders-app") | .consumers[]] as $c | ($c[] | select(.id == "consumer-2") | .status) == "STOPPED" and ([$c[] | select(.id != "consumer-2") | .raw.assignment[]] | length) == 6
